risks.risk: The laptop may not be the claimed model (Alienware m16 r1)
risks.proof: A clear shot of the model label on the bottom of the laptop or a system information screenshot showing the exact model and specs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Alienware gaming laptop, not the specific m16 r1, which may be significantly less valuable.

risks.risk: The CPU may not be the claimed Ryzen 9 7845HX
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information (e.g., from Windows Task Manager or CPU-Z) showing the exact CPU model and specs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the CPU is not confirmed, which could mean a lower-tier CPU, reducing value.

risks.risk: The laptop may have physical damage or wear not visible in the photos
risks.proof: A full 360-degree video or multiple close-up photos of the chassis, hinges, screen edges, and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming minor wear, but could be lower if damage is found.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be functional or may have hardware issues
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop powering on, booting into OS, and running a benchmark or game.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which is the worst-case scenario for a used laptop.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop.
A screenshot of the system information showing CPU, RAM, and GPU specs.
A video of the laptop powering on and running a game or benchmark.
Close-up photos of all ports, hinges, and screen edges for damage assessment.
